_note: Every campus-specific string the class picker, the sign-in and the rail show lives here, never in code. `campuses` is a list: a new campus is a new entry, never a code change. Per campus: id, label, term and term_label, pre_enrollment and roster_updates_until (null when unknown), start_card (the start screen's card), closed_notice (the picker with no roster), rail_closed_line (the rail with no roster), privacy_line, eligibility (category id to words), programs (each with its categories and the v15 program group it belongs to: business, analytics, cs, ece, infosci, or null), relevance (the band thresholds), signin_domains (email domains sign-in accepts; empty: sign-in not open for this campus) and catalog (true when a roster is loaded for it). A program row marked unverified is a first pass the owner has not confirmed.
